purpose: Original PARK industry-page editorial refresh following four user-specified references.

preserved.catalogueData: Four public industry groups, 47 active products and existing product slugs preserved. Industry introductions and product-page context refreshed.

editorialPolicy.wording: All website sentences were newly written for PARK. No quotations, translations of complete source sentences, or source-page images are reproduced.
editorialPolicy.sourceUse: Short factual references inform application context. The independent design-brief and FAQ copy is written around the repository's current product families and existing EPP selection guidance.
editorialPolicy.scope: PARK manufacturing and development language follows the user's authorised general manufacturer positioning; no plant, equipment, capacity or customer claim is added.
editorialPolicy.sourceDerivedLimit: Keep the factual synthesis associated with each requested reference within 180 words; expand usefulness through original project-planning questions, existing catalogue context and general material guidance.

sources.title: EPP solutions for childcare professionals
sources.facts: The page presents EPP applications in educational play, childcare accessories, storage and seating. It highlights low weight, resilience and moulded design possibilities.
sources.editorialUse: Application context only. Sports, footwear and helmet entries are retained from the existing PARK catalogue; the combined public industry stays unchanged.

sources.title: Emballages pour la logistique en plastique
sources.facts: The page covers protective foam packaging, insulated containers, returnable formats and pallets. Handling, stacking, transport exposure and product location are recurring design considerations.
sources.editorialUse: Broad application context. PARK's packing-station walkthrough, project questions and operational brief are independently written around its current product families.

sources.title: Pièces plastique sur mesure pour le secteur CVC
sources.facts: This URL currently covers HVAC: heat-pump components, heating insulation, hydraulic interfaces and ventilation. It discusses combining thermal, acoustic and mounting functions in shaped foam parts.
sources.editorialUse: Retain HVAC scope. Original copy prioritises air paths, seams, access and component evaluation; no domestic-appliance category is added.

sources.title: Solutions plastiques pour l'automobile
sources.facts: The page identifies moulded foam uses in impact-related parts, seating, vehicle storage and shuttle trays. It discusses low weight and energy absorption.
sources.editorialUse: Application context. PARK's assembly-review narrative, sample questions and programme brief are independently written for its existing automotive families.

sources.title: EPP material properties
sources.facts: EPP is a closed-cell polypropylene foam with low weight, energy absorption, resilience and thermal insulation. Its density can be selected for the application.
sources.editorialUse: General material basis for lightweight structure, compression response and insulation statements. Brand-specific environmental or supply-chain claims are excluded.

supportingExistingGuidance.verificationNote: This document was already used for the existing verified EPP guide. The browser tool could not reopen the PDF during this refresh; no new document-specific facts were introduced.

proprietaryClaimsNotImported: Knauf certifications, laboratory credentials or named innovation facilities
Company history, factory counts, machinery fleets and production capacity
Customer names, customer case studies or measured customer results
Proprietary brands and named product ranges
Guaranteed safety, guaranteed acoustic or thermal performance, or blanket chemical resistance
Infinite recyclability, universal recycling access or unqualified environmental savings
technicalBoundaries: Helmet, child-seat and automotive impact performance is evaluated in the complete finished assembly.
Foam water absorption does not establish condensation prevention or watertightness.
Logistics includes existing EPS and rigid-polymer formats; the copy does not relabel every product as EPP.
Reuse depends on a defined operating route, cleaning and inspection.
Grade, density and geometry remain part of the specification.

visualPolicy.imagery: Existing project illustrations plus four separately generated industry hero assets.
visualPolicy.note: Illustrative component scenes are not evidence of a particular PARK factory, customer installation or qualified production part. Alt text describes the depicted component context.
